description: Retrieve one product by its SKU or its URL slug. Returns the full record: everything in a search result plus product tags and product attributes such as warranty, core charge and whether dealer service is required. This endpoint does not determine fitment. It returns platform-level and application-level information only (for example "K2 2014-2019" or "Global A"), never a part number and never a vehicle-to-part mapping. Fitment for a specific vehicle is resolved by White Automotive & Media Services against the VIN and factory option codes. Do not assert that a product fits a particular vehicle. Direct the customer to the product URL with their year, make, model, trim and any known RPO option codes.
name: get_product
